query:
UPDATE services SET
  shortDesc = 'We show you your sewer line on the spot, in minutes. Our free sewer video camera inspection is included with every service call, a $400 value at no charge to you.',
  longDesc = 'Most drain and sewer problems are invisible until they cause real damage. A slow drain might be a minor grease buildup, or it might be a collapsed section of pipe 10 feet underground. The only way to know is to look.

We include a free sewer video camera inspection with every service call. Our technicians push a high-resolution camera through your drain line and show you exactly what is happening in real time on a monitor at the job site. You see what we see. There is no guessing, no upselling based on symptoms alone, and no recommending repairs you do not actually need.

The camera records footage of the full length of the accessible pipe, documenting the condition of joints, the presence of root intrusion, any cracks or offsets, and the location of any blockages. After the inspection, we walk you through the footage and explain what we found in plain language. If there is a problem, we tell you what it is, where it is, and what your options are. If the pipe is in good shape, we tell you that too.

For homeowners buying or selling a property in London Ontario, a pre-purchase sewer inspection is one of the most valuable things you can do. Many older homes in London have clay tile sewer lines that are decades old. A camera inspection before you close can reveal problems that a standard home inspection will miss entirely.

The inspection is free. The information it gives you is not.',
  benefits = '[{"title":"Free With Every Service Call","desc":"A sewer camera inspection is a $400 value included at no charge with every Discount Drain service call. You see exactly what is in your pipe before any work begins."},{"title":"Real-Time On-Site Viewing","desc":"The camera footage is displayed on a monitor at the job site. You watch the inspection as it happens and see the same footage our technician sees."},{"title":"Recorded Documentation","desc":"The inspection is recorded so you have documentation of your pipe condition. Useful for insurance claims, property sales, and tracking changes over time."},{"title":"Pre-Purchase Inspections","desc":"Before buying a home in London Ontario, a camera inspection of the sewer line can reveal clay tile failures, root intrusion, and other problems that standard home inspections miss."}]',
  metaTitle = 'Free Sewer Camera Inspection London ON | $400 Value | Discount Drain',
  metaDesc = 'Free sewer video camera inspection with every service call in London Ontario. See your pipe in real time. $400 value at no charge. Call Discount Drain: 519-451-8342.'
WHERE slug = 'sewer-camera-inspection';
